title: 10b10t
description: 10b10t is a Minecraft anarchy server with no rules, no bans, and no map resets. Duplication exploits are allowed, the world never wipes, and the server runs a 64 chunk render distance. Do whatever you want.
body:
10b10t is a Minecraft anarchy server running on the latest version of the game. There are no rules, no bans, and no map resets. Players are free to do whatever they want, whether that's building, griefing, stealing, or cooperating with others.
The server allows duplication exploits and does not restrict any gameplay mechanics. The world has been running continuously since launch and is never wiped, meaning the history of every player who has joined is preserved in the map.
If you're looking for a survival experience without admin interference or artificial restrictions, 10b10t is the place to play.
